{{Quote|You Je'daii couldn't prevent the fall of Ska Gora!''"<br />"''No&mdash;and many Je'daii fell in that battle.|[[Volnos Ryo]] and [[Rajivari]]|<ref name="DOTJ 11" />}}
The '''fall of Ska Gora''' was a battle that saw the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] capture the forest [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ska Gora]], one of the [[Settled Worlds]], during their [[Invasion of the Tython system|invasion]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] that began in [[25,793 BBY]]. After being [[First battle of Tython|repelled]] from the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the Rakata took Ska Gora, and many members of the [[Je'daii Order]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in battle there. In the aftermath of Ska Gora's capture, the other Settled Worlds joined forces with the Je'daii in defense of the Tython system. From Ska Gora, the Rakata then [[Battle of Shikaakwa|attacked]] the planet [[Shikaakwa]] in [[25,792 BBY]].<ref name="DOTJ 11" /> The battle on Ska Gora had been predicted many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in advance&mdash;in [[25,800 BBY]], the [[Je'daii]] [[Daegen Lok]] and [[Hawk Ryo]] experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of Ska Gora's conquest in the [[Chasm]] on Tython, though the vision drove Lok mad.<ref name="DOTJ 7">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The fall of Ska Gora first appeared in a vision to Daegen Lok in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''The Prisoner of Bogan 2'']], an issue in the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series,<ref name="DOTJ 7" /> and the event was later mentioned in the issue [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Force War 1'']] as having actually occurred.<ref name="DOTJ 11" />
